identityReviewRetry.reason: Drenonia's frozen face repeats the tall-eyed fine-nose youthful face of Otharene, Marvenene and Evrela; native has more level heavy lids and compact central features.
identityReviewRetry.observedSource: Native Drenonia has light green level almond eyes with heavier upper lids, soft cheeks, a short compact nose and thin-upper/full-lower mouth, with a narrow small chin and gathered chestnut hair.
